title: LTM book
description: A book file is the single source for a town's rooms: the engine (ltm-engine/engine/rooms.js) builds every room from it. tools/validate-book.mjs checks the rules this schema cannot (verse counts, library ids, builders, anchors).

chOffset.description: The book starts mid-way: chapter 1 of this file is shown as chapter 1 + chOffset (town.json has the same value)

partial.description: A prototype chapter: fewer rooms than the verses need is a warning, not an error

layout.description: Defaults for every vignette in the chapter; a room's own layout overrides them key by key

rooms.description: ceil(verses/5) rooms, in clockwise order starting nearest the district entrance on the left. The book lists every room of the town, in order; nothing is placed that the book does not list.

position.description: [x, z] in world units, or relative to a named anchor that the town registers with defAnchor(): the anchor's position plus dx, dz

height.description: A height in world units: a number, or the terrain height at a position plus an offset

spread.description: half-width and half-depth of the square of five objects

minY.description: lowest height the room's floor may sit at

object.description: One object, in order: near-left, far-left, far-right, near-right, centre. Vignette objects name a library object by id; the objects of a custom room only carry labels (its builder places them).

id.description: Object library id (ltm-engine/objects, listed on ltm-engine/library/). "TODO" marks an unfinished room.

what.description: The label shown at the spot in the town

desc.description: Fuller description of the object, as approved by the owner

args.description: Extra arguments for the library builder (colours, counts); the library gives defaults

centre.description: The 5th object is a centrepiece the town places itself (a statue, an altar fire): the marker rests at this height

extra.description: Stands in the room but has no verse: a natural furnishing of the place. Comes after the verse spots

place.description: A spot that is a feature of the place itself (a corner of a wall, a rock, a doorway), not an object; has no id (method rule 4)

kind.description: "vignette" (default): five library objects on a square, built by the engine. "custom": the town's own builder places the room

builder.description: custom rooms: a builder registered with defBuilder(), e.g. "colossae.marketStall"

args.description: custom rooms: arguments for the builder

viewer.description: where you stand to look at it

bannerLift.description: raise the room-name banner by this much

fallback.description: custom rooms: a plain vignette the builder falls back to when its special assets are missing
